subject: Data Engineering
title: Big Data in Finance
description: A quick, practical guide to Big Data in Finance.

hook.text: A hedge fund processes satellite images of parking lots to predict retail earnings before they're released.

buildup.text: Financial firms use big data for fraud detection, algorithmic trading, and risk modeling.

discovery.text: Real-time streams of market data, news feeds, and social sentiment all feed trading algorithms.

twist.text: Milliseconds matter. A one-millisecond advantage in data processing can mean millions in profit.

climax.text: Finance was one of the first industries to invest in big data — and remains the most demanding.

punchline.text: In finance, faster data means faster money.

quiz.question: Why is processing speed critical in financial big data?
options: Millisecond advantages translate to significant profit
